text: Figure 2.34: Software Packaging The existence of the Software Cluster (as outcome of Software Cluster Integra- tion) by itself is not sufficient for installation. Actually , the Software Cluster gets wrapped into an Adaptive Software Package that comes with an own manifest format (the SW Package Description ) that is at least partly standardized. The difference between the semantics of a Software Cluster and the semantics of Adaptive Software Package is that a Software Cluster focuses on the structure of the software itself while the Adaptive Software Package is created to handle the logistics aspect of the software installation.
